title: Caffeic acid phenethyl ester inhibits neuro-inflammation and oxidative stress following spinal cord injury by mitigating mitochondrial dysfunction via the SIRT1/PGC1alpha/DRP1 signaling pathway.
authors: Zhang, Yanan; Deng, Qian; Hong, Hongxiang; Qian, Zhanyang; Wan, Bowen; Xia, Mingjie
one_liner_zh: 该文研究CAPE通过SIRT1/PGC1alpha/DRP1通路抑制脊髓损伤后神经炎症与氧化应激，仅含分子对接但无蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: The treatment of spinal cord injury (SCI) has always been a significant research focus of clinical neuroscience, with inhibition of microglia-mediated neuro-inflammation as well as oxidative stress key to successful SCI patient treatment. Caffeic acid phenethyl ester (CAPE), a compound extracted from propolis, has both anti-inflammatory and anti-oxidative effects, but its SCI therapeutic effects have rarely been reported. METHODS: We constructed a mouse spinal cord contusion model and administered CAPE intraperitoneally for 7 consecutive days after injury, and methylprednisolone (MP) was used as a positive control. Hematoxylin-eosin, Nissl, and Luxol Fast Blue staining were used to assess the effect of CAPE on the structures of nervous tissue after SCI. Basso Mouse Scale scores and footprint analysis were used to explore the effect of CAPE on the recovery of motor function by SCI mice. Western blot analysis and immunofluorescence staining assessed levels of inflammatory mediators and oxidative stress-related proteins both in vivo and in vitro after CAPE treatment. Further, reactive oxygen species (ROS) within the cytoplasm were detected using an ROS kit. Changes in mitochondrial membrane potential after CAPE treatment were detected with 5,5',6,6'-tetrachloro-1,1',3,3'-tetraethyl-imidacarbocyanine iodide. Mechanistically, western blot analysis and immunofluorescence staining were used to examine the effect of CAPE on the SIRT1/PGC1alpha/DRP1 signaling pathway. RESULTS: CAPE-treated SCI mice showed less neuronal tissue loss, more neuronal survival, and reduced demyelination. Interestingly, SCI mice treated with CAPE showed better recovery of motor function. CAPE treatment reduced the expression of inflammatory and oxidative mediators, including iNOS, COX-2, TNF-alpha, IL-1beta, 1L-6, NOX-2, and NOX-4, as well as the positive control MP both in vitro and in vivo. In addition, molecular docking experiments showed that CAPE had a high affinity for SIRT1, and that CAPE treatment significantly activated SIRT1 and PGC1alpha, with down-regulation of DRP1. Further, CAPE treatment significantly reduced the level of ROS in cellular cytoplasm and increased the mitochondrial membrane potential, which improved normal mitochondrial function. After administering the SIRT1 inhibitor nicotinamide, the effect of CAPE on neuro-inflammation and oxidative stress was reversed.On the contrary, SIRT1 agonist SRT2183 further enhanced the anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects of CAPE, indicating that the anti-inflammatory and anti-oxidative stress effects of CAPE after SCI were dependent on SIRT1. CONCLUSION: CAPE inhibits microglia-mediated neuro-inflammation and oxidative stress and supports mitochondrial function by regulating the SIRT1/PGC1alpha/DRP1 signaling pathway after SCI. These effects demonstrate that CAPE reduces nerve tissue damage. Therefore, CAPE is a potential drug for the treatment of SCI through production of anti-inflammatory and anti-oxidative stress effects.
abstract_zh: 背景：脊髓损伤（SCI）的治疗一直是临床神经科学的重要研究焦点，抑制小胶质细胞介导的神经炎症及氧化应激是成功治疗SCI患者的关键。咖啡酸苯乙酯（CAPE）是从蜂胶中提取的化合物，具有抗炎和抗氧化作用，但其对SCI的治疗效果鲜有报道。方法：我们构建了小鼠脊髓挫伤模型，并在损伤后连续7天腹腔注射CAPE，以甲泼尼龙（MP）作为阳性对照。采用苏木精-伊红、尼氏和Luxol Fast Blue染色评估CAPE对SCI后神经组织结构的影响。使用Basso Mouse Scale评分和足迹分析探讨CAPE对SCI小鼠运动功能恢复的作用。通过Western blot分析和免疫荧光染色评估CAPE处理后体内外炎症介质和氧化应激相关蛋白的水平。此外，使用ROS试剂盒检测细胞质内的活性氧（ROS）。用5,5',6,6'-四氯-1,1',3,3'-四乙基咪碳菁碘化物检测CAPE处理后线粒体膜电位的变化。机制上，通过Western blot分析和免疫荧光染色检查CAPE对SIRT1/PGC1alpha/DRP1信号通路的影响。结果：CAPE处理的SCI小鼠表现出较少的神经元组织损失、更多的神经元存活和减少的脱髓鞘现象。有趣的是，CAPE处理的SCI小鼠运动功能恢复更好。CAPE处理降低了炎症和氧化介质的表达，包括iNOS、COX-2、TNF-alpha、IL-1beta、IL-6、NOX-2和NOX-4，以及阳性对照MP在体外和体内的水平。此外，分子对接实验显示CAPE对SIRT1具有高亲和力，且CAPE处理显著激活了SIRT1和PGC1alpha，并下调了DRP1。进一步，CAPE处理显著降低了细胞质中的ROS水平并增加了线粒体膜电位，从而改善了正常的线粒体功能。给予SIRT1抑制剂烟酰胺后，CAPE对神经炎症和氧化应激的作用被逆转。相反，SIRT1激动剂SRT2183进一步增强了CAPE的抗炎和抗氧化作用，表明CAPE在SCI后的抗炎和抗应激作用依赖于SIRT1。结论：CAPE通过调节SIRT1/PGC1alpha/DRP1信号通路，在SCI后抑制小胶质细胞介导的神经炎症和氧化应激，并支持线粒体功能。这些效应表明CAPE减少了神经组织损伤。因此，CAPE通过产生抗炎和抗应激作用，是治疗SCI的潜在药物。
